{
  "name": "stock-alarm",
  "version": "0.3.1",
  "description": "Stock Alarm (SA) mod: a boxed watchlist table docked above the prompt (or a live one-line ticker strip), a /sa watchlist pane, local price alerts, and /sa commands to add, remove, dock, and open symbols on Stock Alarm Pro (pro.stockalarm.io). Quotes come from Stock Alarm's public tickers feed.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Shawn Carpenter",
    "email": "shawn14@gmail.com"
  },
  "homepage": "https://stockalarm.io",
  "repository": "https://github.com/shawn14/claude-stock-alarm",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "stocks",
    "stock-alarm",
    "quotes",
    "price-alerts",
    "mod"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "watchlist": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Default watchlist",
      "description": "Space- or comma-separated symbols used until you change the list with /sa add or /sa rm",
      "default": "AAPL NVDA MSFT TSLA"
    },
    "quote_endpoint": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Quote endpoint",
      "description": "Optional URL template for quotes. Use {symbol} for one request per symbol or {symbols} for one bulk request. Empty means Stock Alarm's public tickers feed. The SA_QUOTE_ENDPOINT environment variable overrides this.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "refresh_seconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Refresh interval (seconds)",
      "description": "How often to refresh quotes",
      "default": 30,
      "min": 10,
      "max": 600
    },
    "display": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Where to show the watchlist",
      "description": "panel: a boxed watchlist table docked above the prompt (folds to the one-line ticker strip when the terminal is under 30 rows or 60 columns). band: just the one-line strip above the prompt. status: one line under the prompt. off: only the /sa pane. /sa dock and /sa undock override this.",
      "options": [
        "panel",
        "band",
        "status",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "panel"
    },
    "panel_rows": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Docked table rows",
      "description": "How many symbols the docked table shows (triggered alarms first). /sa dock N overrides this.",
      "default": 5,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 25
    }
  }
}
